tasks.short: Design supply chains for cost and impact.

steps.what: Map the current supply chains and their costs.
Sum environmental impacts from the activity factors.
Design chains that cut cost without raising impact.
Check that the design can still serve the lanes.
Issue the supply-chain design to the planner.

tasks.design: {BI} sums impacts from a factor table on the {ERP} lane file. The analyst designs the chain. {EMAIL} sends it only after the service check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost and impact were argued from two different spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Activity factors can be applied to lanes that already have a volume.
tasks.still_hard: A factor for a mode the site cannot use produces a false saving.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which lane cannot change mode.

ambition.what: Show impact beside cost on a chain the planner already runs.

tasks.altitude: The design stays. The impact sum does not.

reach.task: Change a lane the design has recommended
reach.learn: Which factor produced the impact figure

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from the lane file and a factor table to a sent design. The factor table is an assumption until the customer confirms the factors.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are lane id, mode, volume and factor. Fallback: a lane with no factor is excluded from the impact sum.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which emission factors the customer accepts.
research_questions: How often a lower-impact mode fails the service check.

already_counted.description: Designing the chain and checking service

incremental.description: Keep activity factors aligned with the modes in use

approvals.approved_version: design the analyst checked for service

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Complete factors save the sum and the send. The design stays. The low case is a lane with no accepted factor. No supplier time is included.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model fuel, pricing and carbon scenarios.

steps.what: Set the circumstances the scenarios must change.
Build models for fuel, road pricing and carbon taxes.
Predict which lanes break under those scenarios.
Judge whether the predicted impact is believable.
Write the scenario note for the planner.
Planner says which scenario the network can absorb.

tasks.design: The analyst sets the circumstances. {BI} runs the models and lists lanes that break. The note records only the impacts the analyst believes. The planner's reply is not the analyst's time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scenarios were one-off workbooks with unnamed assumptions.
tasks.enabler_now: A base lane file can be recalculated when a price changes.
tasks.still_hard: A tax rate that is not law yet must not be presented as a forecast of fact.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can say which circumstance the network has never faced.

ambition.what: Rerun the same scenarios when a fuel or tax figure changes.

tasks.altitude: Setting the question and judging the impact stay. The recalculation does not. Planner time is not saved.

reach.task: Say which scenario the network can absorb
reach.learn: Which price was an assumption and which is contracted

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from a stated circumstance to a scenario note. The planner's reply is other-role time and is not saved. Unpublished tax rates are scenarios, not predictions of law.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are lane id, base cost, price change and tax assumption. Fallback: a lane with no base cost is excluded.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which carbon and road-price assumptions the customer will allow in a note.
research_questions: How often the planner rejects the lane the model flags first.

already_counted.description: Judging whether the predicted impact is believable

incremental.description: Keep base lane costs aligned with current contracts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A complete base file saves the model run. The judgement stays. Planner time is not saved. The low case is a price the base file cannot express.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List logistics support requirements from the brief.
Match facility details and staffing needs to the list.
Judge the safety and maintenance plans still open.
Record the support requirements that remain.

tasks.design: The brief becomes a requirement list. {SPREADSHEET} matches facility details and staffing numbers. The analyst judges which safety and maintenance plans are still open.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support needs were a checklist copied from the last project.
tasks.enabler_now: Facility and staffing fields can be matched to a list.
tasks.still_hard: A matched headcount can still be unsafe for the task.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can see a maintenance plan that exists on paper and not on the floor.
tasks.altitude: Judging the open plans stays. The match does not.

reach.task: Close a maintenance gap the note has left open
reach.learn: Which requirement was matched and which was judged open

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from a brief to a support note. Hiring and the safety sign-off are other tasks.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are requirement id, facility id, staffing count and plan status. Fallback: a requirement with no facility is left open, not matched to a default.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
research_questions: How often a matched requirement is still unsafe.

already_counted.description: Judging plans the match cannot close

incremental.description: Keep requirement types aligned with the briefs in use

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Current facility and staffing fields save the match. The safety judgement stays. The low case is a brief whose requirements have no facility.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the equipment and the facility limits.
Draft specifications for the material-handling systems.

loop.purpose: Draft specifications from the stated limits.
loop.stop: Stop after one draft or when a line has no limit.
loop.why_not_simpler: A catalogue specification ignores this facility's limits.

steps.what: Check the draft against the facility layouts.
Engineer marks a specification the layout cannot build.
Issue the specifications the layout can build.

tasks.design: Limits feed one draft. The analyst checks it against the layouts. The facilities engineer marks what cannot be built. The analyst issues only after that mark. Engineer time is not saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications were copied from a catalogue and then found not to fit.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can cite limits that are already written down.
tasks.still_hard: The engineer, not the draft, knows what the layout can hold.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can refuse a line the layout will not support.
tasks.altitude: Checking and issuing stay. The first draft does not. Engineer time is not saved.

reach.task: Mark a specification the layout cannot build

evidence.claim: A volume or a rate can be summed from fields. A site walk and a promise to a customer cannot.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from stated limits to issued specifications. The engineer's mark is other-role time and is not saved. The issue is approved only after that mark.
Test the existing {ERP} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are limit id, equipment class and layout reference. Fallback: a line with no limit is dropped.
EU data-protection rules apply. Monitoring named people needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which layouts the engineer will mark in the same week.
research_questions: How often the engineer rejects a line the draft included.

incremental.description: Keep equipment classes aligned with the layouts

approvals.approved_version: specifications issued after the engineer mark

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Written limits save the first draft. The check, the engineer's mark and the issue stay partly manual. Engineer time is not saved. The low case is a layout the engineer has not marked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Site walks, contract judgement and what is promised to a customer stay with the analyst. Volume sums and document drafts do not.
reach: Contract owners, on which commitment fields a gap list needs.
Facilities engineers, on which site facts a layout needs.
skills_to_grow: Refusing a saving that the site cannot run.
role.ambitious_version: A proposal to a customer names the constraint, the option and the person who may commit.
